english.title: Store slurry otherwise than in slurry storage system satisfying Schedule 2

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Water Resources Control of Pollution Silage
Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil Wales Regulations 2010

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person having custody or control of slurry, stored it otherwise than in a slurry storage system that satisfied the requirements of Schedule 2 to the Water Resources (Control of Pollution) (Silage, Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil) (Wales) Regulations 2010
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4 and 10(1) of the Water Resources (Control of Pollution) (Silage, Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil) (Wales) Regulations 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
having custody / control of slurry
failed to store it in a satisfactory slurry storage system

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
